description: This file defines a FastAPI router handling resume upload functionality. It includes an endpoint '/resumes/upload' which accepts a resume file, reads and decodes its content, creates a resume record in the database, initiates an analysis task in the background, and returns an upload response containing the analysis ID.

classes.name: UploadResponse
classes.description: Data model representing the response containing the analysis ID after resume upload.

methods.name: upload_resume( background_tasks: BackgroundTasks, file: Annotated[UploadFile, File()], user_id: Annotated[int, Form()], resume_repo: ResumeRepository = Depends(), orchestrator: AnalysisOrchestratorService = Depends(), )
methods.description: Asynchronous function handling the resume upload process, including reading the file, creating resume record, starting background analysis, and returning the response.
